title: Dejan's Olympia lineup and favorite street trumpet players
summary: Current Olympia personnel, then his favorite street trumpeters (Manuel Perez, Red Allen, Guy Kelly, Wooden Joe) and clarinetists.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Trumpeters I admired: rating the horn players

blocks.x: Did you name the favorites in the brass band?

Well, they're always my favorite, but in the brass band I had Sheik and Orny Canyon Leonard. Sometimes used three trumpets, sometimes used two trumpets and three reeds and Jesse Charles. And used Clarence and I used Louis Couture or Willie Humphrey.

Nelson and Eddie Summers. I mean them your favorite fellas. Yeah. In the old days. In the old days. What favorite music that I liked the best? Well in the street my favorite trumpet player was Manuel Perez and Red Allen in the street. That's my favorite trumpet player. Manuel Perez, Red Allen, Willie Pazio and so he's living in Nightward, Maurice Duran. And then later on when Guy Kelly came here, I used to like to hear Guy play too because he could blow. He was very powerful in the street you see. And a powerful man in the street he was always noticing. I used to really like to hear him play. I mean not leaving Mr. Landry because he was a very good street man too. And Shotzi was a very good street man. But my favorite like I said, Man of the Reyes, Willie Pazio, Pushy Humphrey, Ray Allen, Guy Kelly. You know that. Yeah. It was good. And another one, you see I used to, so many good trumpet players you used to admire them all. Not all but I mean you used to admire them like Wooden Joe. He was a good street man too. Yeah. Yeah. And your prime ones and the sacks players. In your old days. Well in the old days, well, Lorenzo Teo and Willie Humphrey was my favorite clarinet players. Was my favorite.
